import { Component } from '@angular/core'; import { CommonModule } from '@angular/common'; import { RouterModule, Router } from '@angular/router'; import { AuthService } from '../../../core/services/auth.service'; @Component({ selector: 'app-driver-shell', standalone: true, imports: [CommonModule, RouterModule], templateUrl: './driver-shell.component.html', styleUrls: ['./driver-shell.component.scss'] }) export class DriverShellComponent { constructor(public authService: AuthService, private router: Router) {} switchRole(role: string) { if (role === 'client') this.router.navigate(['/client']); else if (role === 'admin') this.router.navigate(['/admin']); } }
